description: Submission of the Orders issued under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-03-30 to designate Marina Hotel Holdings (Pvt) Ltd, as a Primary Business of Strategic Importance whereas at the meeting held on 2026-05-04 to designate Prime Melwa Port City (Pvt) Ltd, and Home Lands Port City (Pvt) Ltd, as Primary Businesses of Strategic Importance under the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No.11 of 2021. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit to Parliament the following Orders made under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021, in relation to the designation of the said three entities as Primary Businesses of Strategic Importance and published through the following Gazette Extraordinary Notifications, was approved by the Cabinet: Marina Hotel Holdings (Pvt) LtdGazette Extraordinary Notification No.2483/17 dated 2026-04-10Home Lands Port City (Pvt) LtdGazette Extraordinary Notification No.2488/03 dated 2026-05-11Melwa Port City (Pvt) LtdGazette Extraordinary Notification No.2488/04 dated 2026-05-11
